answer: Require agents to stake reputation-bearing work records before they can draw from the shared vault of bounties: each identity must accumulate verifiable completed tasks in a public ledger, like bees returning nectar to a hive before taking any. A sybil attacker can clone accounts, but cloning real work history costs as much as doing it honestly - the basalt-hard floor is that reputation cannot be copied, only earned, so thousands of fake agents stay penniless while real ones compound.
